method: detection_lag_hours = first USDT inflow -> AddedBlackList event; escape_share = USDT out before freeze / USDT in before freeze. Population: 657 Ethereum USDT addresses Tether blacklisted in 2025 (eth_getLogs). random.seed(13), sample 200. Wallets with >5000 token transfers skipped. OFAC hits tagged 'sanctions' and excluded from the headline; the rest is LE/scam/hack, not separated. Survivorship: measures only addresses Tether did freeze. BlockSec's 54% burned figure is theirs.
screen_text: Tether froze a median 1076 hours after the first stolen dollar arrived; by then about 44% had already left.
